data.gender_notes: Fawziyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fawziyyah is a Quranic name derived from the root F-W-Z, meaning vigilant or watchful. It signifies being aware of one's surroundings and actions, and is often associated with being kind and just. The name Fawziyyah carries the meaning “Vigilant, Watchful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fawziyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody vigilant, watchful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is vigilant and watchful in their faith and actions, and is rewarded with guidance and protection.
data.etymology: Fawziyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vigilant, Watchful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawziyyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Fawziyyah
in_english.meaning: Conqueror, victorious, successful, dominant, judge, world conqueror, victorious, successful, dominant, judge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fawziyyah is derived from the Arabic root f-w-z, which means conqueror, victorious, successful, dominant, judge, and world conqueror. In Islamic tradition, Fawziyyah is associated with the qualities of success, victory, and dominance, as well as the ability to judge and make decisions. The name Fawziyyah is also associated with the concept of fawz, which means success, victory, and triumph. In modern times, the name Fawziyyah is often given to girls born into Muslim families, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia, where the name is considered a symbol of good fortune and prosperity.
